data.title: 雅儿贝德 · 巡查时发现了门闩上的磨痕
data.description: 北门的门闩推到一半就卡住了。雅儿贝德侧过身，俯看门闩上新露出的一道银亮划痕，再用两指把它提离卡槽。贴墙的灯刚好照见连着肩甲和护手的紫色细缝。
data.action: 俯身辨认门闩的磨痕，用两指将它提离卡槽
data.lighting: 门内壁灯侧光与铠甲细紫光
data.camera: 前侧中景，手与门闩和肩甲同框
data.promptProse: Albedo leans toward the gate latch in her full black plate armor, with her face visible and the helmet retracted. She finds a fresh scrape in the iron and lifts the latch slightly with two gauntleted fingers. Side light from a wall lamp picks out the spiked shoulder plates and the thin glow in their seams.
data.animaCaption: She lifts the iron latch just far enough to expose the fresh scrape where it catches.
